SELECT toString(properties.transaction_id) AS txn,
       toString(properties.$insert_id) AS iid,
       toString(properties.click_id) AS cid,
       toString(properties.sub_id) AS sub,
       toString(properties.aff_sub2) AS aff_sub2,
       toString(properties.platform) AS plat,
       toString(properties.conversion_type) AS ct,
       toString(properties.revenue) AS rev,
       toString(properties.raw_query) AS raw,
       toString(toTimeZone(timestamp,'Asia/Shanghai')) AS t
FROM events WHERE event='Order_Converted'
  AND toString(properties.transaction_id) IN ('102e210fb60b4489ccf90c2eb7aad4','1025b14eca74012aad216ae2f933c9','1024a405690cbea72223c3ecefc0e4','102524f5f3d971d4d460ce886709af','102b6f0db2b44ff5f3f57a362f4335','1021fa03bbe74546c6111b9cf79db4','10225e81ebeaa44361919beb27804e')
ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 30
